code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), anemia with increased red cell count and distribution width, leukopenia with lymphopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR, and mildly elevated creatinine. These findings suggest acute severe respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
